description.zh: 为每条更新日志增加日期，并修复更新日志页面标题双语显示。
description.en: Added dates to every changelog entry and fixed the changelog page title translation.

description.zh: 修复动态视频加载标题双语显示，并修复评论区匿名/GitHub 标签切换。
description.en: Fixed the dynamic video loading title translation and the anonymous/GitHub comment tab switching.

description.zh: 增加更新日志入口、日志页面和管理者编辑功能。
description.en: Added the changelog entry point, changelog page, and manager editing tools.

description.zh: 增加浅色/深色自适应页面加载动画。
description.en: Added a light/dark adaptive page loading animation.

description.zh: 支持系统深色模式和右上角手动切换。
description.en: Added system dark mode support and a manual top-right theme toggle.

description.zh: 增加拍摄年月字段，详情页展示时间，首屏按时间选最新。
description.en: Added shooting year/month metadata, displayed it on detail pages, and used it to choose the latest hero video.

description.zh: 加强前端密码逻辑，改为哈希和会话校验。
description.en: Strengthened the front-end password flow with hashing and session validation.

description.zh: 评论区支持 GitHub 登录留言和匿名留言。
description.en: Added GitHub-authored comments and anonymous comments.

description.zh: 连接 Firebase Realtime Database，让点赞数线上共享。
description.en: Connected Firebase Realtime Database so like counts are shared online.

description.zh: 每个视频增加点赞功能和点赞总数显示。
description.en: Added likes and total like counts for each video.

description.zh: 修复手机端查看作品弹窗被首屏遮挡。
description.en: Fixed the mobile work menu being covered by the hero section.

description.zh: 作品卡片使用视频第一帧，并支持鼠标悬停播放。
description.en: Replaced artwork placeholders with video first frames and hover playback.

description.zh: “查看作品”按钮改为可选择浏览全部或按地区浏览。
description.en: Changed the View Works button to offer all videos or region browsing.

description.zh: 大厅首屏自动使用最新上传或最新拍摄时间的视频。
description.en: Made the hall hero automatically feature the latest uploaded or latest shot video.

description.zh: 修复视频详情页语言自动切回中文的问题。
description.en: Fixed video detail pages automatically switching back to Chinese.

description.zh: 航拍作品区增加按名称搜索功能。
description.en: Added title search to the aerial works section.

description.zh: 地图点击洲后只显示该洲作品目录。
description.en: Made continent clicks filter the region lists to only that continent.

description.zh: 优化整体视觉：语言按钮动画、圆角、排版和细节。
description.en: Polished the visual design with animated language controls, softer corners, and refined layout details.

description.zh: 每个视频详情页增加留言评价区。
description.en: Added a comment and review area under each video detail page.

description.zh: 上传和编辑视频时支持填写拍摄设备。
description.en: Added shooting gear fields when uploading or editing videos.

description.zh: 修复右上角“作品”入口后瑞士·稻田不显示的问题。
description.en: Fixed Switzerland's Field not appearing after using the top-right Works entry.

description.zh: 管理者模式支持修改已发布视频描述。
description.en: Added manager editing for published video descriptions.

description.zh: 确认“杭州小灯塔”作为大厅首屏作品入口。
description.en: Confirmed Hangzhou Lighthouse as the hall hero work entry.

description.zh: 大厅首屏改为“杭州小灯塔”，并可点击观看。
description.en: Changed the hall hero to Hangzhou Lighthouse and made it clickable.

description.zh: 删除视频增加独立删除密码。
description.en: Added a separate delete password for video removal.

description.zh: 添加管理者入口，支持自主上传、分类、描述和删除视频。
description.en: Added a manager area for uploading, categorizing, describing, and deleting videos.

description.zh: 添加访问密码页，输入密码后进入大厅和视频页。
description.en: Added an access password page before the hall and video pages.

description.zh: 清理超过 100MB 的旧视频并整理仓库推送。
description.en: Cleaned up the oversized video file and pushed the organized repository.

description.zh: 将瑞士视频替换为更小体积版本。
description.en: Replaced the Switzerland video with a smaller version.

description.zh: 将“瑞士·稻田”视频加入欧洲列表，并通过列表进入视频。
description.en: Added Switzerland's Field to the Europe list with list-based video entry.

description.zh: 重绘更真实的世界地图视觉。
description.en: Redrew the world map with a more realistic look.

description.zh: “查看作品”接入世界地图，按地区进入作品。
description.en: Connected View Works to a world map for region-based browsing.

description.zh: 添加中英双语切换。
description.en: Added Chinese and English language switching.

description.zh: 建立个人航拍网站基础框架：首页、介绍和作品独立页结构。
description.en: Built the first aerial portfolio framework with a home page, introduction, and individual work pages.
